requirements.label: intro
requirements.title: Introductory Marine Sciences course
requirements.sourceText: MAR 101 - Long Island Sound: Science and Use 3 credits; OR; MAR 104 - Oceanography 3 credits

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: At least 15 credits from the following
requirements.sourceText: At least 15 credits from the following: Upper-division MAR courses; BIO 343 - Invertebrate Zoology Laboratory 2 credits; BIO 353 - Marine Ecology 3 credits. Notes: No more than three credits each of MAR 487 and MAR 488 may be applied toward this requirement.

requirements.label: overlap
requirements.title: Credits not shared with a major or other minor

rule.text: At least 12 credits applied to the minor may not be applied to any major or other minor.
rule.reason: Cross-program credit overlap limit has no rule type in the schema

requirements.sourceText: At least 12 credits applied to the minor may not be applied to any major or other minor.

requirements.label: pass-no-credit
requirements.title: Pass/No Credit limit

rule.text: No more than one three-credit course may be taken under the Pass/No Credit option.
rule.reason: Pass/No Credit limit has no rule type in the schema

requirements.sourceText: No more than one three-credit course may be taken under the Pass/No Credit option.

policies.sourceText: All upper-division courses offered for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.

notes.text: Intended primarily for science majors; the minor assumes completion of basic courses in mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, or geology. Undergraduate Advisor: Nancy Black, nancy.black@stonybrook.edu. Research opportunities are available through faculty or the SoMAS website (http://www.somas.stonybrook.edu).
